hook: A perfectly normal scripting language. Really.

beats.say: NormalScript is a small, fast virtual machine for a subset of JavaScript, built to run little scripts and agent code inside your app.
It embeds as a library, a pure JavaScript package for Node twenty-four or newer, or Bun one point four or newer, with no WebAssembly module, native addon or isolate to wire up.
You create a runtime, pass in plain host functions, and run, with timeouts and abort signals built in.
